sections.heading: The Trap Playbook: Advanced Dink Strategies

traps.name: Crosscourt Patience → Then Break Pattern
traps.why: Crosscourt = safest dink (low net, largest margin)
traps.how: Build rhythm crosscourt, then surprise middle or line
traps.pro_example: Anna Leigh Waters PPA final example

traps.name: Attack the Feet Until They Lean — Then Lob
traps.why: Consistent dinks to feet force opponents forward
traps.how: Once they lean, lob into open space
traps.anecdote: The lob isn't cheap — you earn it by dinking first

traps.name: Confuse Them with the Middle
traps.why: Middle dinks create hesitation in doubles
traps.how: Mix middle balls into rallies to cause miscommunication
traps.pro_note: Riley Newman quote about middle dinks winning rec games

traps.name: The Patience Play (Mental Warfare)
traps.why: Long rallies test nerves more than strokes
traps.how: Stay calm, recycle balls, wait for opponent to crack

traps.name: Partner Pressure — Move as One
traps.how: One holds crosscourt, partner poaches middle
